The idea

Most energy drinks hit hard and leave you worse off. VOLTZ is built the other way. Green tea for a steady lift. Real fruit for flavor. No sugar, no artificial anything. Just clean energy that feels like you.

What’s inside

Four things.
That’s the list.

Green tea caffeine
Real fruit
0g sugar
Nothing artificial
01

Green tea

Natural caffeine from green tea extract. A smoother, steadier lift than the sharp hit you get from a lab-made shot.

02

Real fruit

Orange, mango and passionfruit give every flavor its taste. The flavor comes from the fruit, not from a flavoring factory.

03

Zero sugar

0g added sugar. A touch of monk fruit and stevia leaf keeps it bright and a little sweet, and still just 10 calories.

04

Nothing else

No artificial flavors, no artificial colors, no preservatives. If we wouldn’t cook with it, it doesn’t go in the can.

0g

Added sugar. Many energy drinks carry around 27g.

100%

Natural flavors, from real fruit and botanicals.

10cal

Per can. Bright, crisp and light.

150mg

Caffeine per can, all of it from green tea.
